"""CWE-22 safe: basename confinement and literal path."""

import os
from pathlib import Path


def read_named(root: str, user_path: str):
    name = os.path.basename(user_path)
    return open(os.path.join(root, name))


def read_hosts():
    return open("/etc/hosts")


def read_confined(root: str, user_path: str):
    base = Path(root).resolve()
    full = (base / user_path).resolve()
    if str(full).startswith(str(base)):
        return open(full)
    raise ValueError("path escape")
